mapper.select: SELECT FROM s_user_venue_favourite f JOIN s_venue v ON v.id=f.venue_id WHERE f.user_id=#{userId} AND v.status <> 'DRAFT' ORDER BY f.created_at DESC, f.venue_id DESC

SELECT FROM s_booking b JOIN s_venue v ON v.id=b.venue_id WHERE b.user_id=#{userId} AND (b.status IN ('CONFIRMED','COMPLETED','NO_SHOW','ENDED_UNTRACKED') OR b.status='CANCELLED' AND b.payment_status IN ('REFUNDING','REFUNDED','REFUND_FAILED')) AND v.status <> 'DRAFT' GROUP BY v.id,v.name,v.city,v.district,v.address,v.cover_path,v.status ORDER BY MAX(b.created_at) DESC, v.id DESC LIMIT 20
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO s_user_venue_favourite(user_id,venue_id) VALUES(#{userId},#{venueId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE venue_id=VALUES(venue_id)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM s_user_venue_favourite WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND venue_id=#{venueId}
